needs.semantics: CR 702.103: casting a creature card for its bestow cost makes it an Aura spell with enchant creature; it enters attached, is not a creature while attached, and becomes a creature again if the enchanted creature leaves. Today AltCost.id has no bestow and nothing switches an object between creature and Aura, so the printed 'Bestow {cost}' line can be claimed by no declaration and by no ability.
